form.current-chamber: In the House of Representatives, U. S.,
form.official-title: Providing for the adoption of the concurrent resolution (S. Con. Res. 5) setting forth the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2021 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2022 through 2030.

section.text: That Senate Concurrent Resolution 5 is hereby adopted.
